chunks: Al-Sadiq عليه السلام said to some of his companions:
"Cut your hair short so that its dirt, pests, and grime may lessen; your neck will become stronger, your eyesight will become clearer, and your body will find relief."

key_terms.اِسْتَأْصِلْ: cut off thoroughly or shorten closely

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام teach about cutting hair short and its benefits?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches personal cleanliness and grooming as part of proper conduct. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام recommends shortening the hair because of its practical benefits for cleanliness, bodily ease, and physical well-being.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.325 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said to some of his companions:
"Cut your hair short to reduce its dirt, pests, and grime; it will strengthen your neck, improve your eyesight, and provide relief for your body."
